question: For customers with at least 5 total transactions, what is their transaction success rate? Return the customer name and success rate, ordered from lowest to highest success rate. To determine if a transaction is successfull it's status has to be 'success'
Original question: For customers with at least 5 total transactions, what is their transaction success rate? Return the customer name and success rate, ordered from lowest to highest success rate.
Modification: It adds more context to the question. Added the definition that a transaction is successful if its status is “success”.
sql: WITH cust_tx_stats AS (SELECT c.sbCustId, c.sbCustName, COUNT(t.sbTxId) AS total_tx, SUM(CASE WHEN t.sbTxStatus = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_tx FROM sbCustomer AS c JOIN sbTransaction AS t ON c.sbCustId = t.sbTxCustId GROUP BY c.sbCustId, c.sbCustName) SELECT sbCustName, CAST(success_tx AS FLOAT) / total_tx * 100 AS success_rate FROM cust_tx_stats WHERE total_tx >= 5 ORDER BY CASE WHEN success_rate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, success_rate;

question: How many transactions for stocks occurred in each of the last 8 weeks excluding the current week? How many of these transactions happened on weekends?Weekend days are Saturday and Sunday. The week starts on Monday

question: For users in the US and Canada, how many total notifications were sent in each of the last 3 weeks excluding the current week? How many of those were sent on weekends?Weekends are Saturdays and Sundays. Truncate created_at to week for aggregation.
Original question: For users in the US and Canada, how many total notifications were sent in each of the last 3 weeks excluding the current week? How many of those were sent on weekends?
Modification: Specified that weekends are Saturdays and Sundays and instructed to truncate created_at to week for aggregation.
sql: SELECT date(n.created_at,  '-' || ((strftime('%w', n.created_at) + 6) % 7) || ' days') AS WEEK, COUNT(*) AS total_notifications, COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', n.created_at) IN ('0', '6') THEN 1 END) AS weekend_notifications FROM notifications AS n JOIN users AS u ON n.user_id = u.uid WHERE u.country IN ('US', 'CA') AND n.created_at >= date('now',  '-' || ((strftime('%w', 'now') + 6) % 7) || ' days', '-21 days') AND n.created_at < date('now',  '-' || ((strftime('%w', 'now') + 6) % 7) || ' days') GROUP BY WEEK;
